{{Quote|Borgo Prime is filled with people who have no conscience&mdash;thieves, murderers, creatures who would just as soon kill you as greet you.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Iltar]], to [[Tenel Ka Djo|Beknit]]|<ref name="Young Jedi Knights: Shadow Academy">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Shadow Academy]]''</ref>}}
'''Borgo Prime''' was an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] that served as a [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
Before it had been a spaceport, Borgo Prime was originally a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] colony.<ref name="TEA" />

Over the course of millennia, the asteroid was hollowed out by [[Mining/Legends|miners]]. By approximately [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]], the [[Miner/Legends|miners]] had left Borgo Prime a bare, sponge-like rock, with its resources completely depleted. However, when the miners had left, they left behind the equipment that had been used to make Borgo Prime habitable. As a result, Borgo Prime transitioned from being barren and lifeless into a bustling center of trade and commerce.

By [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], it served as a financial center of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].<ref name="SotP">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>
